data.sub: Wiaan Mulder ne test cricket mein banaya sabse anokha record.

chat.say: Bhai yeh record maine pehle kabhi nahi dekha!
Wiaan Mulder ne kamaal kar diya aaj toh.

data.asar: Cricket history mein ek naya chapter jud gaya bhai.
data.caption:
Test cricket ka sabse naya aur alag record ban gaya hai dost!

🏏 Wiaan Mulder ne racha naya itihas
🌍 Duniya yaad rakhegi yeh naam

Aise records roz-roz nahi dekhne ko milte bhai!

Comment mein batao: Aapke hisaab se yeh sabse bada record hai kya?
